card.name: Digits inside numbers and section numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (mostly 2, 4 or 5) that starts or sits inside a number, such as a section number after a period, or a digit inside a chemical or enzyme name.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: Digit after a section heading's period or just before it, as in 4.2 or 5.2.
modes.example: hepatic transaminase levels <<4>>.2 Hypersensitivity to any component

modes.label: Digits in compound names
modes.description: Digit inside a drug, enzyme or vitamin name such as 25-hydroxyvitamin D, 2D6 or 5-fluorouracil.

modes.label: Digits in quantities
modes.description: Leading digit of a number in a count, time or amount.
modes.example: LDH <<2>>4 hours with the exception of bilir

card.plain: It fires on a lone digit that begins or sits inside a number or name, like a section number or 25-hydroxyvitamin D.
